entries.en: to reprove, to chide; to press someone with admonition
entries.notes: L 栏「arrexir enserian lo」残损难解，义据 H「督責」及 M 音 tō chē 定。

entries.en: to admonish with gentle words; to persuade kindly

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕（Correo 条仅存交叉参照注「見後文／本篇開頭」，汉字与官话栏空白）
entries.en: 〔original defective; gloss uncertain〕 (the Correo entry carries only a cross-reference note; Hanzi and Mandarin columns are blank)
entries.notes: H、R 两栏空缺，仅存西语交叉参照注，无对译可定。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕（西语栏作 frijoles guisados「燉煮豆類」，汉字、闽南语、官话三栏皆空）
entries.en: 〔original defective; gloss uncertain〕 (Spanish reads 'frijoles guisados', stewed beans; all three CJK columns are blank)
entries.notes: 三栏皆空，仅西语可读，无对音可校。

entries.en: to run; to go on foot
to bolt, to run off (of a horse or other animal)
entries.notes: M 栏为多音节短语且含「馬」音，与单字 H 不完全对应，义取「奔竄」。

entries.zh: 幼畜追隨母畜奔走（原稿汉字作「淵」，与义不合，疑为借音字）
entries.en: to run after its mother (of a young animal); the Hanzi 淵 is phonetically borrowed and does not fit the sense
entries.notes: H「淵」与「幼獸隨母」义不合，M/R 并作 ién、yèn，只能存疑。

entries.en: to flow, to run (of water)
to gather and flow (of water); vast, brimming water
entries.notes: H「汪」本义为水广、水聚，与「水流」略异，M 兼收 ong、lāu 两读。

entries.zh: 水波相連、漣漣不絕（水流綿延）
entries.en: rippling, continuous flow of water
entries.notes: L 末字残损（despandadve），义据 H「漣」与 M 三读定。

entries.en: to gallop, to ride at full speed
to drive on / spur a horse; to gallop
to gallop, to speed along
to flee, to scurry off; to run

entries.zh: 如浪湧般奔去、騰湧而去
entries.en: to surge away like waves; to rush off in waves
entries.notes: L 末词「ringararade」残损，义据 H「浪去」定。

entries.zh: 奔跑、跑走（原稿汉字作「泡」，疑即「跑」）
entries.en: to run, to run off (the Hanzi 泡 is probably a stand-in for 跑)
entries.notes: H「泡」于义无取，R 作 pâu 近「跑」，姑存疑。

entries.zh: 策馬疾馳（原稿「縛馬」与义不合，疑当作「轡」）
entries.en: to gallop / push on a horse (the Hanzi 縛馬 contradicts the sense; pì suggests 轡 'bridle')
entries.notes: H 与 L 义相反，音 pì 近「轡」，判为形近误书。

entries.en: to run hastily, to bustle along (a priesa)
entries.notes: [疑] 标记致 H 未定，义据 L「a priesa（匆忙）」与 M「僕僕走」定。

entries.zh: 搶先奔在前頭、領頭疾行
entries.en: to run ahead, to take the lead
entries.notes: R 栏与 M 栏出入较大，义据 H「竄做頭行」定。

entries.zh: 頂風冒浪、冒海上風濤之險（汉字栏「舵」当作「擔」）
entries.en: to brave wind and water; to run the risks of the sea
entries.notes: H「舵」音 tām 与「擔」合，当作「擔風水」。

entries.zh: 頂風冒湧、冒險航行於濤浪間
entries.en: to brave wind and swelling seas
entries.notes: 同上条，H「舵」当作「擔」，与「湧」合为「擔風湧」。

entries.en: to travel the world, to roam far and wide
entries.notes: R 栏音与「遊」不合，然 L、H、M 三栏一致。

entries.zh: 橫衝直撞地狂奔、凶猛地跑去
entries.en: to run recklessly, to rush headlong
